7. Nico's personal items (phone, lunchbox, water bottle, charger) frequently reside on counter_k1. Evidence: d08-d09 observations show consistent presence.

9. Residents are not always present when items are on counter_k1. Evidence: d08 07:20, d09 00:00 showed items present with nobody in the room. This supports the staging zone hypothesis.
